name: driven-dissipative Rydberg ensemble (mean-field optical bistability)
question: Does a detuning sweep of the Rydberg ensemble cross a fold of its mean-field bistability (threshold write)?
assumptions: Bloch equations with Delta -> Delta + V rho_rr (Carr 2013 eqs. 1a,b; Marcuzzi 2014 eqs. 3-5), V/Gam = -11 (Carr)

provenance.source: Carr, C., Ritter, R., Wade, C. G., Adams, C. S., Weatherill, K. J., 'Nonequilibrium phase transition in a dilute Rydberg ensemble', Phys. Rev. Lett. 111, 113901 (2013), arXiv:1302.6621 (full text of arXiv v3; the arXiv abstract page lists the title 'Cooperative non-equilibrium phase transition in a dilute Rydberg ensemble'; journal title checked against Crossref); Marcuzzi, M., Levi, E., Diehl, S., Garrahan, J. P., Lesanovsky, I., 'Universal nonequilibrium properties of dissipative Rydberg gases', Phys. Rev. Lett. 113, 210401 (2014), arXiv:1406.1015 (full text); Saffman, M., Walker, T. G., Molmer, K., 'Quantum information with Rydberg atoms', Rev. Mod. Phys. 82, 2313 (2010), arXiv:0909.4777 (full text)
